item.title: Tatiana Schlossberg - DesignObserver
item.description: On this episode, Debbie talks to journalist Tatiana Schlossberg about what we can do, as individuals, about climate change.

item.title: How Janelle Monáe Built a Creative Empire on Her Own Terms - DesignObserver
item.description: Janelle Monáe joins The Design of Business | The Business of Design to discuss artistic independence, living authentically, and building a creative community. In a time of political and cultural upheaval, her insights on courage and self-expression feel more relevant than ever. Listen now.

item.title: Beauty For Sale - DesignObserver
item.description: Beauty is a business — a design business — that demands conformity, especially among non-conformists.

item.description: On this episode Debbie talks to two designers about the history of user-friendly design and the importance of designing for feedback.

item.title: Design Observer Appoints Hugh Weber as New Managing Director - DesignObserver
item.description: In this new role with Design Observer, Weber will work with the senior leadership team to develop programs and partnerships that amplify design’s critical role in civil society.

item.title: The Apperception Test That Sealed My Fate - DesignObserver
item.description: I’ve been influenced by many images, sounds, and words, but unbeknown to me, my future once hinged on my response to one 8-by-10 illustrated card.

item.description: An interview with Oleg Veklenko, a Ukrainian graphic designer conscripted into the cleanup and mitigation near the exploded Chernobyl nuclear reactor in the first “hottest” two months of accident.
